commonChecks: Every original state.read still enters the original persistence.transaction('dashboard'), executes its original authorize before and after, preserves abort/sameAuthority, and returns commit:false.
Write-mode namespace health is an authority condition, not a mutation. No producer command/prepare/evaluate/apply/send/dispatch handler is executed by these observations.
No observer opens its own transactionAll/readSnapshotRoot. The existing choice fence recognizes and reuses an original local snapshot scope while preserving its checks.
All admitted UI leases finish in their original finally blocks.
The original local-store readonly root owns fresh SQL rows, detached copies, poison-on-write, joined reader lifetime and final closure. No readiness or authority results are cached.
All three original context admissions remain outside observation roots, and the two operational invocations open separate fresh roots.
The arbitrary host input.operational extension starts and is awaited outside the host root. Only its concrete local implementation independently opens its own audited raw-store root.
limitations: Static audit is not runtime equivalence proof; the installed comparison is separately recorded in attempts/phase-equivalence-01.json.
Read counts are source-structure counts with all candidates eligible, not observed SQL benchmark counts. Physical effects require clean Actions evidence.
